```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes"))) |>
  add_position_group(collect(select(tbl(con, "roster"), playerId, season, position))) |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded")
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
udfa <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(entrants = n(), udfa = sum(outcome_signed_udfa_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(share = udfa / entrants) |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  mutate(
    group_f = factor(group, levels = rev(group)),
    route = if_else(share < 0.5, "Mostly drafted", "Mostly undrafted")
  )

p <- ggplot(udfa, aes(100 * share, group_f)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = route,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s: %s of %s entrants arrived undrafted (%.1f%%)",
        group, fmt(udfa), fmt(entrants), 100 * share
      ),
      data_id = group
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 100 * share - 1, label = pct(share)), hjust = 1, colour = "white", size = 5.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Mostly drafted" = "#D95F02", "Mostly undrafted" = "#7570B3"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Undrafted share of NFL entrants by position group",
    subtitle = "Share of each group's entrants who arrived undrafted; quarterbacks in orange, the only group under half",
    x = "NFL entrants who arrived undrafted",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "undrafted-share-by-position", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-class
udfa_class <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  group_by(group, draft_year) |>
  summarise(entrants = n(), udfa = sum(outcome_signed_udfa_d), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(share = udfa / entrants)
p_class <- ggplot(udfa_class, aes(draft_year, 100 * share, colour = group)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line_interactive(aes(data_id = group, tooltip = group), linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      data_id = group,
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %d class: %d of %d entrants undrafted (%.0f%%)",
        group, draft_year, udfa, entrants, 100 * share
      )
    ),
    size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_colour_position() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(risk$draft_year), max(risk$draft_year), 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Undrafted share by position group and draft class",
    subtitle = "Share of NFL entrants who arrived undrafted",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Entrants undrafted (%)",
    colour = NULL,
    caption = "Dashed line: half of entrants. Small groups swing widely; hover a point for the counts."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
card_interactive(p_class)
```
